items.summary: Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in Apache Thrift Java bindings. This issue affects Apache Thrift: before 0.24.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.24.0, which fixes the issue. (CVSS: 8.2)

items.title: libheif 1.18.0 before 1.23.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in…
items.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in libheif versions 1.18.0 up to but not including 1.23.3 in the function uncdecodermixedinterleave::processTile(). This flaw allows attackers to write out of bounds by crafting HEIF files with chroma components of unequal bit depths, potentially leading to code execution during image processing. (CVSS: 7.5)

items.title: AJ-Report through 1.7.1 signs share tokens with a hard-coded JWT secret, allowing attackers to forge… (CVE-2026-120209)
items.summary: AJ-Report versions through 1.7.1 use a hard-coded JWT secret to sign share tokens. This allows attackers to forge valid share tokens offline. By crafting a token with the reportCode 'dataSet', attackers can access the testTransform endpoint, which executes scripts via GroovyClassLoader without authentication, leading to remote code execution. (CVSS: 9.8)

items.title: Jpom 2.10.0 through 2.11.12 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to…
items.summary: Jpom versions 2.10.0 through 2.11.12 have an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain super-administrator access by injecting query conditions into the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header. This enables attackers to execute commands via Jpom's script features. (CVSS: 9.8)

items.title: LearnHouse before 1.1.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the assignment API that allows authenticated…
items.summary: LearnHouse versions before 1.1.1 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the assignment API. This flaw allows authenticated users to access other users' grades, submissions, and instructor feedback by supplying another user's ID to certain endpoints. The vulnerability exposes sensitive academic data without proper access controls. (CVSS: 4.3)

items.title: Security update for perl-Mozilla-CA
items.summary: This security update for perl-Mozilla-CA addresses the denial of trust for the emSign ECC Root CA - G3 certificate due to CVE-2026-113812. The update includes an updated Mozilla CA certificate bundle as of 2026-10-20, which denylists this compromised certificate and updates the trusted root certificates accordingly.

items.title: Security update for stgit
items.summary: This security update for stgit addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including CR/LF/NUL injection in git-daemon connect requests via crafted git URL paths and denial of service issues related to pack version 3 headers and ofs-delta base distances. The update also introduces new features and improvements in version 2.7.0.

items.summary: This security update for Tailscale addresses multiple issues across several versions, including fixes for security vulnerabilities related to WireGuard packet handling, IPv6 link-local traffic, and Tailscale SSH Unix socket permissions. items.title: Security update for python-CairoSVG
items.summary: A security update for python-CairoSVG addresses a vulnerability (CVE-2026-107378) where rendering an attacker-controlled SVG with a path containing many segments can cause quadratic CPU consumption, potentially leading to denial of service.

items.summary: This security update for gosec addresses multiple issues including fixes for specific rule detections, improvements in timeout handling, and updates to dependencies and Go versions. items.title: Security update for epiphany
items.summary: This security update for the Epiphany browser addresses two vulnerabilities: a path traversal issue in WebExtension XPI extraction (ZIP slip) and a JavaScript code injection vulnerability via unsanitized CSS selectors from element IDs in autofill functionality. Both vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to manipulate file paths or inject malicious code.

items.title: Security update for cadvisor
items.summary: This security update for cadvisor addresses two vulnerabilities in the golang.org/x/net/http2 package: CVE-2026-78669, which causes excessive CPU consumption due to repeated initial window changes, and CVE-2026-97032, which can lead to an HTTP/2 server crash caused by a race condition in the HPACK encoder.

items.title: Security update for hauler
items.summary: This security update for hauler addresses multiple vulnerabilities including a client IP spoofing issue in the github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 package and fixes credential and presigned URL leaks along with other functional improvements. The update also includes a version bump to 2.1.2 and upgrades Go to 1.27.2.

items.title: Security update for coredns
items.summary: This security update for CoreDNS addresses multiple issues including excessive CPU consumption and a server crash related to HTTP/2. The update includes a fix for CVE-2026-78669 and CVE-2026-97032 by updating the vendored golang.org/x/net package to version 0.60.0. Additional improvements and new features are also included in version 1.15.0.

items.title: Security update for aws-nitro-enclaves-cli
items.summary: Multiple security issues in the rustls-webpki and serdewith libraries used by aws-nitro-enclaves-cli have been fixed in version 1.5.2. These include panic conditions triggered by malformed certificate revocation lists, incorrect acceptance of name constraints for URI names and wildcard certificates, and faulty matching logic for certificate revocation lists.

items.title: Security update for gvfs
items.summary: A security update for gvfs addresses a local privilege escalation vulnerability due to a race condition in the gvfs-admin socket ownership. This flaw allows local users to change ownership of root-owned files, potentially escalating their privileges on the affected system.

items.title: Security update for ansible-core
items.summary: A security update for ansible-core addresses CVE-2026-89091, which allows an attacker to trick a victim into installing a malicious collection. This malicious collection can overwrite arbitrary files with the privileges of the user running ansible-galaxy, potentially leading to code execution on the control node.

items.title: Security update for cifs-utils
items.summary: A security update for cifs-utils addresses a vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-104715, which involves mount options injection through the parsing of CIFS credentials files. This issue could allow an attacker to influence mount options improperly.
